fc149bdda052a23ffe9a6a7bae0d8f71d08a8a5f.summary: This is a project README for godoh, a proof-of-concept command-and-control framework written in Go that uses DNS-over-HTTPS as its transport. It describes installation, build steps, command-line usage and a GPL v3 license. It is a software project page rather than a threat report, so it records no actors, incidents, CVEs or other threat facts.

fc74c428b0bccae718df1f0f92eb7e2c9105b5d3.summary: Aqua Nautilus report on perfctl, a Linux malware it says has been active for about 3-4 years. Initial access is via a RocketMQ flaw (CVE-2023-33246), and the malware attempts a Polkit flaw (CVE-2021-4034) for root. It hides using rootkits, masquerades its processes, runs a Monero cryptominer, and uses Tor and proxy-jacking services. The report describes scanning for over 20,000 misconfigurations and gives detection and mitigation advice.
